name: core
notes: v3.3.0: Track B of the Codex co-existence workstream (DC-104) — the structural half. Adds /configure-project, a new companion skill (CORE now ships seven) that bootstraps and health-checks a project for the current harness — the Codex-side counterpart to Claude Code's startup mandate: confirms install + manifests, validates the memory store, resolves workspace identity (detect-only), reports connector capability in two honest tiers (configured-on-disk vs session-live — never asserts a capability it can't verify), runs the capability probe, and generates AGENTS.md from CONTRACT.md when one exists. Idempotent; report-only unless --apply. Fixes a real shipped fork-check bug: checkFork compared paths with resolve() while the CLI canonicalizes with realpathSync, so a symlinked project root (macOS /tmp->/private/tmp, OneDrive) re-forked an already-registered workspace every startup. Hardens generate-agents-md against an uncaught ENOENT on a missing CONTRACT.md. Also rolls up the already-on-next workspace-identity field standardization (on `path`) and the R-17 adversarial-run-gate wiring into protocols/analysis.md (ADVISORY watermarking — enforced, not closed). Honest scope: built + validated from a Claude session; the Codex branch is fixture-tested, live two-harness validation (Crest, ai-gw-placement) is the remaining external step. Cleanup note for a follow-up: plugins/core/RELEASE.json is a pre-collapse stale duplicate (read by nothing; CI + bump use this root file) and should be removed.
